description: CWA Open Data Platform (氣象資料開放平台) is a data portal run by Central Weather Administration, Taiwan. The platform offers forecasts, observations, radar, typhoon, earthquake and tsunami data and marine data of the weather administration as files and an API with a free authorization code. Coverage: Taiwan and surrounding seas. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as json, xml; access is free of charge; the API needs a free authorization code. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("氣象資料開放平台") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support weather and earthquake inputs for Taiwan infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
